Chapter 1 course package:
・This package includes 7 basic theory videos about Cardano, how to install and run tests.

・Collect and analyze comments and feedback from the community.
・Collect the number of likes and feedback from the community for each lecture video and statistics in the google sheet file.

・Publish the learning roadmap and all academic documents related to the Aiken programming language
・Target for positivity: Interactions for each video (Including comments on the course and each lecture) are greater than 70% positive across total interact
